subject: Eval access activation & success matrix — next steps
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Singh <ravi.singh@zenstack.io>, Elena Moreno <elena@novahealth.co>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval access activation & success matrix — next steps

Hi Ravi / Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Recap + proposed next steps below so we have a single source of truth for the POC kickoff.

Summary of goals (what ZenStack needs to validate):
- End-to-end integration: API calls from dev environment -> Redwood hosted eval model (embedding + chat) with expected latency under 200ms p50 for single-request traffic pattern.
- Functional: embeddings recall >= 85% on the 200-sample evaluation set you shared; chat completion coherence on five canonical prompts.
- Operational: IP allowlist and SSO SAML login verified; audit logs available for the trial window.

Proposed timeline (fast lane, 3-week sprint):
- Day 0 (today): SSO invites + initial IP allowlist entries; share contact for infra/security. (owner: Marissa / Priyom)
- Day 1–3: Temp API key issued with 14-day TTL; integration sample app smoke test. (owner: Vivek)
- Week 1: Performance run with 1k request burst and 10k/day steady; collect latency & cost metrics. (owner: Ava / Priyom)
- Week 2: Evaluate embeddings recall & chat tests; iterate prompts/config. (owner: Ravi + Redwood PM)
- End of Week 3: Joint review + decision criteria met / next steps.

Immediate asks for ZenStack (please reply inline):
1) SSO: SAML metadata or the IdP admin contact. We need one test user (name + email).
2) IP allowlist: CIDR(s) to whitelist for outbound requests to ZenStack, and the CIDR(s) you want Redwood to allow inbound from for your webhook callbacks (if any).
3) Compliance contact for any evidence requests (SOC2/pen-tests).

Attachments: POC-success-matrix.xlsx (success criteria + checklist), temp-api-key-instructions.md (how to swap keys in dev).

I’ll coordinate owners internally: Vivek will generate a scoped temp key, Marissa will send the Console access invite and SSO flow doc, Priyom will handle networking/IP whitelist config, and Olga will scope minimal audit-log exports for the trial.

Proposed check-in: Fri Aug 1, 10:00 AM PT for quick status and to unblock any infra items. If that works for you, I’ll calendar it.

Thanks — Ava
Ava Chen
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0123

Attachment: temp-api-key-instructions.md (text stub)

Thanks Ava — good summary. Team is aligned on the goals and the fast-lane timeline looks fine. Answers inline: 

1) SSO: Our IdP admin is Sanjay Mehta (sanjay.mehta@zenstack.io). He can share SAML metadata; please loop him on the SSO invite. Test user: rachel.test@zenstack.io

2) IP allowlist: For now, you can add these outbound ranges to whitelist on our side: 35.192.0.0/14, 34.120.0.0/16. For Redwood inbound (your webhooks), we will initially accept traffic from 18.205.0.0/16 — we can tighten later.

3) Compliance contact: infra+secu@zenstack.io. They will handle SOC2 and log-level questions; for the trial we only need basic assurances.

Request: Can you create a scoped temp API key limited to embeddings + chat and TTL 14 days? Send the key via secure channel (encrypted Drive link or the stub text in your email). Also helpful if you can provide a short curl example with the header and minimal retry guidance.

We’ll plan to ping you after the Day 1 smoke test and join the Friday check-in.

— Ravi

Olga: please prepare the minimal audit log export (last 30 days format) so we can confirm expected fields for infra+secu. Priyom: please add the CIDRs Ravi provided to the PoC IP allowlist and open the firewall rule template for our ops.

Hi Ravi — quick status update: all owners are on it and initial artifacts are available. See below.

- Temp API key: scoped key created with 14-day TTL. Delivery: secure Drive link sent to infra+secu@zenstack.io and rachel.test@zenstack.io. (Attachment: api-key-stub.txt — contains key-id: rk_zen_20260729 and instructions; full secret delivered via Drive.)
- Console access: Marissa has invited rachel.test@zenstack.io and Sanjay Mehta as SSO admin.
- IP allowlist: Priyom confirmed 35.192.0.0/14 and 34.120.0.0/16 are added to our outbound allowlist; Redwood webhook range 18.205.0.0/16 added to your inbound template.
- Audit logs: Olga attached sample export format to the Drive folder (fields: timestamp, request_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, user_id).

Next steps: please run the Day 1 smoke test (curl sample below) and reply with any errors. If you’re green, we’ll proceed to the performance run next week. Proposed check-in remains Fri Aug 1, 10:00 AM PT.

Curl sample (replace SECRET with the full key in Drive):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \u005c
  -H "Authorization: Bearer SECRET" \u005c
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \u005c
  -d '{"model":"redwood-eval-small","input":"hello"}'

Thanks — I’ll see you at the internal sync later today.

Ava
